author: Nuon Bonong
changelog: Grade 7 Worksheets & Question Bank complete upgrade: audited all mathematical typesetting (eliminated all raw slash fractions, fixed \dots/\ldots and matched KaTeX delimiters); strictly aligned exercises with MoEYS curriculum progression (isolated natural numbers from integers and removed misplaced concepts in Lessons 1-2); updated all 77 points across 22 lessons with 3 distinct difficulty levels (Level 1: ស្រួល / មូលដ្ឋានគ្រឹះ, Level 2: មធ្យម / ការយល់ដឹង និងអនុវត្ត, Level 3: ពិបាក / គិតស៊ីជម្រៅ និងដោះស្រាយបញ្ហា) totaling 231 comprehensive exercises with full teacher solutions, rubrics, and dynamic score calculation (/ ៣).
